1: // Simple Space Salvage game – enhanced graphics
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   let thrustOsc = null;
9:   function startThrustSound(){
10:     if (thrustOsc) return;
11:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     thrustOsc.frequency.value = 100;
14:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     thrustOsc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     thrustOsc.start();
18:   }
19:   function stopThrustSound(){
20:     if (thrustOsc){
21:       thrustOsc.stop();
22:       thrustOsc.disconnect();
23:       thrustOsc = null;
24:     }
25:   }
26:   function playBeep(freq, dur){
27:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
28:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
29:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
30:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
31:     osc.connect(gain);
32:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
33:     osc.start();
34:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
35:   }
36:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
37:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
38: 
39:   // ---- Game objects ----
40:   const ship = {x: W/2, y: H/2, r: 12, speed: 0, angle: 0, fuel: 100};
41:   const cargos = [];
42:   const asteroids = [];
43:   const keys = {};
44:   const maxCargos = 5, maxAsteroids = 3;
45:   const stars = [];
46:   for(let i=0;i<100;i++) stars.push({x: rand(0,W), y: rand(0,H), size: rand(0.5,2)});
47: 
48:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
49: 
50:   function spawnCargo(){
51:     cargos.push({x: rand(0,W), y: rand(0,H), r:8, collected:false});
52:   }
53:   function spawnAsteroid(){
54:     const a = {x: rand(0,W), y: rand(0,H), r:20, vx: rand(-1,1), vy: rand(-1,1)};
55:     asteroids.push(a);
56:   }
57:   for(let i=0;i<maxCargos;i++) spawnCargo();
58:   for(let i=0;i<maxAsteroids;i++) spawnAsteroid();
59: 
60:   // ---- Input ----
61:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.key]=true);
62:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
63: 
64:   // ---- Game loop ----
65:   const trail = [];
66:   function update(){
67:     // record ship trail
68:     trail.push({x: ship.x, y: ship.y, age: 0});
69:     if(trail.length>30) trail.shift();
70:     // increment ages
71:     trail.forEach(p=>p.age++);
72:     // ship movement
73:     const thrust = 0.2;
74:     if(keys.ArrowUp){ ship.speed += thrust; ship.fuel -= 0.05; startThrustSound(); }
75:     else if(keys.ArrowDown){ ship.speed -= thrust; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
76:     else { stopThrustSound(); }
77:     if(keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= 0.05;
78:     if(keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += 0.05;
79:     // constrain speed
80:     ship.speed = Math.max(Math.min(ship.speed, 4), -2);
81:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
82:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
83:     // wrap around edges
84:     if(ship.x<0) ship.x+=W; if(ship.x>W) ship.x-=W;
85:     if(ship.y<0) ship.y+=H; if(ship.y>H) ship.y-=H;
86: 
87:     // asteroids motion
88:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{
89:       a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
90:       if(a.x<0||a.x>W) a.vx*=-1; if(a.y<0||a.y>H) a.vy*=-1;
91:     });
92: 
93:     // cargo collection
94:     cargos.forEach(c=>{
95:       if(!c.collected && dist(c, ship) < ship.r + c.r){
96:         c.collected = true;
97:         ship.fuel = Math.min(ship.fuel + 20, 100);
98:         playBeep(600, 0.1);
99:       }
100:     });
101:     // respawn collected cargo
102:     cargos.forEach((c,i)=>{ if(c.collected){ cargos.splice(i,1); spawnCargo(); } });
103: 
104:     // collision with asteroids
105:     for(const a of asteroids){ if(dist(a, ship) < ship.r + a.r){ gameOver('Hit asteroid'); return; } }
106:     if(ship.fuel <= 0){ gameOver('Out of fuel'); return; }
107:     draw();
108:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
109:   }
110: 
111:   function draw(){
112:     // background gradient (space)
113:     const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,H);
114:     bg.addColorStop(0,'#000020');
115:     bg.addColorStop(1,'#000000');
116:     ctx.fillStyle = bg;
117:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
118:     // stars
119:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
120:     stars.forEach(s=>{ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.size,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
121:     // draw ship trail
122:     ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,200,255,0.3)';
123:     trail.forEach(p=>{
124:       const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - p.age/30);
125:       ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * 0.5;
126:       ctx.beginPath();
127:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
128:       ctx.fill();
129:     });
130:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
131:     // ship
132:     ctx.save();
133:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
134:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
135:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-15,0,15,0);
136:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0,'#00aaff');
137:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff');
138:     ctx.fillStyle=shipGrad;
139:     ctx.beginPath();
140:     ctx.moveTo(15,0); ctx.lineTo(-10,8); ctx.lineTo(-10,-8); ctx.closePath();
141:     ctx.fill();
142:     ctx.restore();
143:     // cargos
144:     cargos.forEach(c=>{
145:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, 0, c.x, c.y, c.r);
146:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaff00');
147:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#006600');
148:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
149:       ctx.beginPath();
150:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
151:       ctx.fill();
152:     });
153:     // asteroids with shading
154:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{
155:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, 0, a.x, a.y, a.r);
156:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbbbbb');
157:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555555');
158:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     });
163:     // UI
164:     ctx.fillStyle='yellow';
165:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
166:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: '+ship.fuel.toFixed(0),10,20);
167:   }
168: 
169:   function dist(a,b){ return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y); }
170:   function gameOver(msg){
171:     // play collision/failure sound
172:     playBeep(200, 0.3);
173:     ctx.fillStyle='red';
174:     ctx.font='30px sans-serif';
175:     ctx.fillText('Game Over: '+msg, W/2-150, H/2);
176:   }
177: 
178:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
179: })();
